notes.title: MUSEUM VOLUME II RELEASED
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33579692/f0adc72fc5a7ae45e840a78f0a46e0be60727be3.png[/img]

[b]Wreck Tangle Games has released the second instalment in the ‘Museum’ series, titled ‘Museum Volume II’. The second part of our journey follows straight on from the first, where our protagonist, the security guard at the ‘The Royal Foyer Museum’ in London, must solve the mysteries surrounding his Museum.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33579692/371fe2afad45bd72591307c3c72a1c7531179f6b.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33579692/e66df43dc5cedc3de6d721f1b9532a2b62111f0e.png[/img]

[b]In Volume II, four new exhibits are now open for us to explore. Straying away from ancient history this time round, the museum has opened up to a more random selection of exhibitions. The exhibits are as follows: Plymouth (Plymouth Rock), Medieval (A Medieval Village), Church (An Historic Church) and Victorian (Victorian London). Exhibits are much bigger in Volume II, with a different selection of puzzles, some of which are more difficult than that found in Volume I. There has also been a definite graphical overhaul from the first Volume, and WTG’s previous games, as this solo developer starts to fine tune his abilities.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1075840/







                       -----------*------------*------------*------------*------------*------------

[b]The Museum Official Soundtrack has also been released on Steam[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.01 - Bug Fixes and Stan Lee
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has played 'Museum Volume I' so far, the latest update fixes some bugs that people have discovered on there adventures in the museum.


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

+ Aiming Dot too small for Circular Puzzle in the Egyptian Exhibit, making it difficult to see where you are grabbing - Have made this bigger.

+ Lava river death sequence not working - Fixed


[b]Plus:[/b]

Due to the recent news of the an absolute legend passing away. I have also added a little memorial to the great Stan Lee. This can be found the first time you enter the foyer, at the start of the game, at the top of the stairs.

I shall keep this in the game for the next week.

I looked up to Stan Lee a lot. His storytelling and character creation have truly inspired me in Game Development. Thank you for all you have given this world.

Rest in Peace you superhuman legend.
